info.name: Bifrost V1 - Rate Limit / Budget
info.description: Rate limit and budget enforcement tests at the wire level. Request limit: VK with request_max_limit 2 allows exactly 2 usage-bearing requests and blocks the 3rd with 429 request_limited (enforcement compares with >=), then recovers after the 1m window. Token limit: token_max_limit 1 blocks the 2nd request with 429 token_limited. Budget: a tiny max_limit blocks with 402 budget_exceeded once cost accrues. Counters are read via GET /api/governance/virtual-keys/{id}?from_memory=true (immediate) - never via /api/governance/budgets, /rate-limits, or /quota, which lag behind the 10s DB dump ticker. Counter-dependent assertions are skip-guarded on priming success so the suite stays green when no provider key is configured. Deeper budget-cycle semantics (calendar alignment, overrides, multi-window) are covered by the Go suite in tests/governance (make test-governance). Model config spelling: a provider-scoped model config budget on chat_model is exhausted by one request, after which the prefixed upper-case spelling and the dated alias of the same model are refused with 402 budget_exceeded while a sibling model is not.

item.name: Model config spelling
item.description: A provider-scoped model config on (chat_model, provider) with a budget that one completion exhausts. Request 1 with the configured spelling succeeds and accrues cost; the same prompt spelled '<provider>/<MODEL>' and as the dated alias is then refused with 402 budget_exceeded, so every spelling of the model is charged to the one budget. A sibling model is not refused by it. The VK's allowlist names the models explicitly (named entries match case-insensitively): a '*' allowlist is matched through the case-sensitive model catalog, so the upper-case spelling would be refused as model_blocked by the VK gate before the budget is consulted. Teardown deletes the model config and the VK whatever the outcome. Counter-dependent assertions are skip-guarded on priming success and on recorded usage, like the budget folder's, so the suite stays green when no provider or pricing is available; the dated-alias case runs only when chat_model_alias is an alias of chat_model (a runner overriding chat_model alone skips it); the sibling check fails on any governance refusal (402 or 403), not only on budget_exceeded.

item.name: Setup - Create VK for model config spelling

exec: // The dated-alias case only proves anything when the alias really is an alias of the
// configured model. A runner that overrides chat_model but leaves chat_model_alias at its
// default would send an alias of another model, so the case is skipped unless the alias
// starts with the configured model name (gpt-4o -> gpt-4o-2024-08-06).
// No budget of its own: the only budget this VK can hit is the model config's.
// The allowlist names the models sent below. A '*' allowlist is resolved
// through the model catalog, which is case-sensitive, so the upper-case
// spelling would be refused as model_blocked (403) by the VK gate before any
// budget is consulted. Named entries match case-insensitively (and the
// validator rejects case-variant duplicates), so one entry per model keeps
// the VK gate open for every spelling and the budget is what decides.
provider_configs: [{provider: provider, weight: 1.0, allowed_models: [model, alias, sibling], key_ids: ['*']}]
pm.test('Create model config VK returns 2xx', function() { pm.expect(code, 'body: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299); });
pm.test('VK has an id and a value', function() {

item.name: Prefixed upper-case spelling is blocked with 402 budget_exceeded

exec: // Same prompt as request 1, model spelled '<provider>/<MODEL>'.
pm.request.body.raw = JSON.stringify({model: provider + '/' + model.toUpperCase(), messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'ok'}], max_tokens: 5});

pm.test('Request is refused with 402', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'body: ' + pm.response.text()).to.equal(402); });

item.name: Dated alias spelling is blocked with 402 budget_exceeded

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('ms_usage_ok')) { pm.test('Skipped: no cost recorded', function() { pm.expect(true).to.be.true; }); return; }
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('ms_alias_ok')) { pm.test('Skipped: chat_model_alias is not an alias of chat_model', function() { pm.expect(true).to.be.true; }); return; }
pm.test('Request is refused with 402', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'body: ' + pm.response.text()).to.equal(402); });

item.name: Sibling model is not blocked by the model config budget

exec: // The budget is scoped to the configured model; a sibling model must not
// resolve to it. The provider's own answer (200 or a provider-side error)
// is not under test here, only that governance did not refuse it. A 403
// model_blocked from the VK gate would also hide the budget from view, so
// any governance refusal fails this check, not only budget_exceeded.
var refused = code === 402 || code === 403 || text.indexOf('budget_exceeded') !== -1 || text.indexOf('model_blocked') !== -1;
pm.test('Sibling model is not refused by governance (402/403, budget_exceeded, model_blocked)', function() { pm.expect(refused, 'status ' + code + ' body: ' + text).to.equal(false); });
